title: Cause tree
summary: The causes as a tree read top to bottom: the trigger, then the root cause, then the contributing causes, each node a card with the handle and the plain twin. Hover a node for its card, click it for the full entry below. A retro with sub-incidents draws one tree per incident. The page renders one at the head of Causes; declare one for the flat list layout.
